name: Turlach Unit 27 EGEO
description: Key Features High Throughput: Processes up to 268 liters per hour, enabling efficient filtration for large-scale water treatment needs. Optimized Operating Temperature: Functions reliably at temperatures up to 47°C, suitable for diverse environmental and industrial settings. Saltwater Compatibility: Designed for feed salinity levels up to 86 parts per thousand, making it ideal for marine, brackish, or desalination applications. Reduced Maintenance Costs: Extended media service life minimizes the need for frequent media changes, saving time and operational expenses. Easy Integration: The electric operation ensures straightforward installation and compatibility with existing electrical infrastructure. Customizable Solutions: Pricing flexibility ensures the product can be tailored to various budgets and project scopes. description_html:
Key Features

  • High Throughput: Processes up to 268 liters per hour, enabling efficient filtration for large-scale water treatment needs.
  • Optimized Operating Temperature: Functions reliably at temperatures up to 47°C, suitable for diverse environmental and industrial settings.
  • Saltwater Compatibility: Designed for feed salinity levels up to 86 parts per thousand, making it ideal for marine, brackish, or desalination applications.
  • Long Media Service Life: Delivers up to 837 hours of continuous use before requiring media replacement, reducing downtime and maintenance frequency.
  • Electric Power Source: Operates with an electrically driven system, ensuring consistent performance and compatibility with standard power supplies.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Water Filtration: The high flow rate and robust design make this sand column suitable for users seeking reliable filtration in high-demand settings.
  • Versatile Application Range: Withstanding elevated temperatures and high salinity, this unit meets the requirements of industrial, environmental, and research-based water processing.
  • Reduced Maintenance Costs: Extended media service life minimizes the need for frequent media changes, saving time and operational expenses.
  • Easy Integration: The electric operation ensures straightforward installation and compatibility with existing electrical infrastructure.
  • Customizable Solutions: Pricing flexibility ensures the product can be tailored to various budgets and project scopes.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Industrial Water Treatment: Ideal for factories, processing plants, and desalination facilities needing consistent, high-volume sand filtration.
  • Environmental Research: Suitable for laboratory studies on hyporheic flow dynamics, sediment transport, or ecological restoration projects.
  • Aquaculture and Marine Applications: Effectively filters saline water for aquariums, fish farms, and marine research centers.
  • Infrastructure Upgrades: Useful for municipalities or organizations upgrading existing filtration systems to accommodate higher throughput or saline feed water.

Frequently Asked Questions Addressed

  • Is this sand column durable for continuous operation? Yes, its long media service life and robust construction support extended use with minimal maintenance.
  • Is the unit easy to install and operate? The electrically powered design simplifies setup and daily operation.
  • Can it handle high-salinity water? Yes, it is engineered for feed salinity up to 86 ppt, making it suitable for challenging water sources.
  • What is the pricing structure? Pricing is determined after acceptance to ensure the best fit for your specific project needs.
